items.title_en: New Dataset Tracks GPU Power Usage for AI Computing
summary_en: AI computing uses a lot of electricity, and its effects on power systems depend on how power usage changes quickly over time.
Current benchmarks for AI models don't provide detailed time-based power data, making it hard to study these patterns.
LLM-PowerTrace is an open dataset that records detailed GPU power measurements over time
key_points_en: AI computing creates fast-changing power demands
Existing benchmarks lack time-series power data
LLM-PowerTrace provides per-GPU power traces
translation_zh: 人工智能计算消耗大量电力，其对电力系统的影响取决于电力使用随时间的快速变化
当前的人工智能模型基准缺乏时间序列电力数据，使得研究这些模式变得困难
LLM-PowerTrace是一个提供每块GPU电力追踪的开放数据集

items.title_en: A New Framework for Trustworthy AI Collaboration
summary_en: Federated Learning (FL) allows AI systems to train together without sharing raw data, but traditional FL lacks proper governance features. This paper introduces GAFL, a method that adds verification, fairness checks, and secure logging to ensure trustworthy collaboration.
GAFL authenticates client data, enforces policies, and detects anomalies to improve AI system reliability.
key_points_en: Adds governance checks to FL processes
Enforces policies during model training
Secures data with tamper-proof logging
translation_zh: 联邦学习（FL）允许AI系统在不共享原始数据的情况下共同训练，但传统FL缺乏治理功能。本文介绍了GAFL，一种添加验证、公平性检查和安全日志以确保可信协作的方法。
GAFL验证客户端数据，执行政策，并检测异常以提高AI系统的可靠性。

items.title_en: Improving Model Training with Agentic Dataset Search
summary_en: Finding training data in large repositories requires more than text relevance because queries include specific constraints like task and license.
Current methods fail to verify if datasets meet these constraints due to missing metadata and flawed verification processes.
Agentic approaches show promise but lack systems to ensure query requirements are actually satisfied.
key_points_en: Queries combine semantic goals with strict constraints
Text retrieval can't enforce hard constraints
Free-form agents don't verify constraint compliance
translation_zh: 在大型数据仓库中寻找训练数据需要超越文本相关性，因为查询包含任务和许可等具体约束
现有方法由于元数据缺失和验证流程缺陷，无法确认数据集是否满足约束
智能代理方法虽有潜力但缺乏确保查询要求被满足的系统

vocab.zh: 训练数据（用于机器学习模型的输入数据）
语义训练目标（描述模型需要学习的抽象概念）
许可约束（数据使用条款的限制条件）
元数据验证（检查数据集属性是否符合要求的过程）
自由形式代理（能自主执行任务的智能系统）

items.title_en: Stocks Opened Optimistically but Closed in Decline Amid AI Fears
summary_en: Big Tech companies' recent earnings reports raised concerns about increased AI spending, causing stock prices to drop.
Investors shifted their money to safer stocks, like those in utilities and healthcare, to protect their investments.
key_points_en: Big Tech earnings reignited AI spending fears
Investors moved to defensive stocks
Market reversal occurred within a week
translation_zh: 大型科技公司的最新财报引发了人们对人工智能支出增加的担忧，导致股价下跌。
投资者将资金转向了公用事业和医疗保健等更安全的股票，以保护自己的投资。

items.title_en: Trump's Energy Cost Promise Fails as Fuel Prices Rise
summary_en: President Trump promised to lower gasoline prices below $2 per gallon during his first term.
However, gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel prices increased instead, contradicting his claims.
This outcome has raised questions about his energy policies
key_points_en: Trump pledged to cut gasoline prices below $2/gallon in his first year
Gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel prices all increased
His energy policies faced criticism for not meeting expectations
translation_zh: 总统特朗普承诺在他任职的第一年将汽油价格降至每加仑2美元以下。
然而，汽油、柴油和航空燃油价格反而上涨了，这与他的承诺相矛盾。
这一结果引发了人们对他的能源政策的质疑。

items.title_en: U.S. Treasury sets new 5.51% bond rate for six months
summary_en: The U.S. Treasury has announced a new 5.51% interest rate for Series I bonds starting now.
This rate will remain valid through April 2027 and helps protect against inflation.
key_points_en: 5.51% is the new bond rate
Rate applies until April 2027
Bonds help protect against inflation
translation_zh: 美国财政部宣布新的5.51%储蓄债券利率，立即生效。
该利率将持续到2027年4月，有助于抵御通货膨胀。

items.title_en: Nvidia Considers Cosigning Loan for Nscale's West Virginia AI Data Center
summary_en: Nvidia might help fund Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia by cosigning a loan.
This move could ease investor concerns about spending on AI projects.
Chipmakers like Nvidia often support infrastructure needed for AI technology.
key_points_en: Nvidia is considering cosigning a loan for Nscale's data center
Investors are cautious about AI spending
Chipmakers can help fund AI infrastructure
translation_zh: 英伟达可能通过为Nscale在西弗吉尼亚州的AI数据中心贷款提供担保来帮助融资。
此举可能缓解投资者对AI项目支出的担忧。
像英伟达这样的芯片制造商经常支持AI技术所需的基础设施。

items.title_en: Salesforce Acquires Defense Tech Startup Rune in $375M Deal
summary_en: Salesforce is buying Rune, a defense technology company, for $375 million. Rune's AI logistics tools will improve Salesforce's Missionforce defense platform.
The deal shows Salesforce's focus on expanding its military technology offerings.
key_points_en: $375M acquisition of Rune by Salesforce
Rune specializes in AI logistics for defense
Missionforce platform gets enhanced
translation_zh: Salesforce以3.75亿美元收购国防科技公司Rune，Rune的人工智能物流工具将提升Salesforce的Missionforce国防平台。
这笔交易表明Salesforce正在扩大其军事技术业务。

items.title_en: Apple CEO Emphasizes Purpose-Driven AI Development
summary_en: Apple's new CEO stated the company prioritizes meaningful AI integration over unnecessary AI features.
The leader defended Apple's cautious approach in the competitive AI landscape.
Focus remains on enhancing user experience rather than rushing AI innovations.
key_points_en: Apple avoids AI for AI's sake
Prioritizes user-centric AI applications
Cautious strategy in AI development
translation_zh: 苹果新任CEO表示，公司优先考虑有意义的AI整合，而非不必要的AI功能。
该负责人捍卫了苹果在竞争激烈的AI领域中的谨慎策略。
重点放在提升用户体验，而非仓促推出AI创新。
